usageNotes: Use this to modify the privilege set of a custom Proxmox role. By default the update replaces the role's entire privilege list; pass `append: true` to add privileges without removing existing ones. The role must already exist (use `post_access_roles` to create it), and the caller requires `Sys.Modify` on `/access`.

examples.summary: Grant VM.PowerMgmt and VM.Console to the existing 'HelpDesk' role, preserving current privileges

tips: Omitting `append` (or setting it false) performs a full replacement — all existing privileges are discarded and only the supplied `privs` list remains.
`privs` is a comma-separated list of Proxmox privilege strings (e.g. VM.Allocate, Datastore.AllocateSpace). Pass an empty string to clear all privileges from the role.
Built-in roles (Administrator, PVEVMUser, etc.) cannot be modified; only custom roles created via the API or UI are editable.
Returns null on success; any error is signalled by a non-2xx HTTP status with a JSON error body.
